# @weight 2

httpd as busybox's, one request a run with -i: the request on stdin and the
response on stdout.  W, /tmp/x-cu-hd/www, is the home (-h), made afresh for
each case: index.html ("hello\n"), s.css ("body{}\n"), r.txt ("abcdefghij")
and an empty directory sub, then the case's own setup run in it, then every
file in it dated 2026-01-02 03:04:05 UTC.  A case gives its setup, its request
as printf's %b reads it, and httpd's arguments past -i -h W.  Every
expectation is busybox's own output for the same request on the same tree:
stdout without its Date line (the clock's), a CR shown as <CR>, then the
status, then stderr.  The last cases run httpd as a listener on a free port
and ask it over a TCP connection.

## the fixture

### a tree, a request, and the report

```cu
(do (import x/sys/socket)
  (def hd-w "/tmp/x-cu-hd/www")
  (def hd-home (sys-getcwd))
  (def hd-sh (fn (_ pre req)
    (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (string-concat (list
      "rm -rf /tmp/x-cu-hd && mkdir -p " hd-w "/sub && cd " hd-w
      " && printf 'hello\\n' > index.html && printf 'body{}\\n' > s.css && printf abcdefghij > r.txt"
      " && ( " pre " ) >/dev/null 2>&1; TZ=UTC find " hd-w " -type f -exec touch -t 202601020304.05 {} +"
      "; printf '%b' '" req "' > /tmp/x-cu-hd/req"))))))
  (def hd-lines (fn (_ s)
    (let go ((i 0) (acc ()))
      (let ((nl (%wget-index s #\newline i)))
        (if (null? nl) (reverse (if (< i (byte-len s)) (pair (substring s i (byte-len s)) acc) acc))
          (go (+ nl 1) (pair (substring s i nl) acc)))))))
  (def hd-show (fn (_ out st err)
    (def body (string-concat (filter (fn (_ l) (not (Str8 starts? "Date: " l)))
                                     (map (fn (_ l) (string-append l "\n")) (hd-lines out)))))
    (string-concat (list (Str8 replace "\r" "<CR>" body) "[status " (%cu-int->str st) "]\n" err))))
  (def hd-case (fn (_ pre req args)
    (hd-sh pre req)
    (sys-dup2 1 9) (sys-dup2 2 8)
    (def oo (file-open-write "/tmp/x-cu-hd/out"))
    (def ee (file-open-write "/tmp/x-cu-hd/err"))
    (sys-dup2 oo 1) (sys-dup2 ee 2)
    (def st (guard (e (do (file-write 2 (string-append "raised: " (if (Err err? e) (e msg) "?"))) -1))
              (cu-run (append (list "httpd" "-i" "-h" hd-w) args) (file-read-all "/tmp/x-cu-hd/req"))))
    (sys-dup2 9 1) (sys-dup2 8 2) (file-close oo) (file-close ee)
    (Sys chdir hd-home)
    (display (hd-show (file-read-all "/tmp/x-cu-hd/out") st (file-read-all "/tmp/x-cu-hd/err")))))
  (def hd-str (fn (_ args)
    (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "mkdir -p /tmp/x-cu-hd"))
    (sys-dup2 1 9) (sys-dup2 2 8)
    (def oo (file-open-write "/tmp/x-cu-hd/out"))
    (def ee (file-open-write "/tmp/x-cu-hd/err"))
    (sys-dup2 oo 1) (sys-dup2 ee 2)
    (def st (cu-run (pair "httpd" args) ""))
    (sys-dup2 9 1) (sys-dup2 8 2) (file-close oo) (file-close ee)
    (Sys chdir hd-home)
    (display (string-concat (list (file-read-all "/tmp/x-cu-hd/out") "|status " (%cu-int->str st) "\n"
                                  (file-read-all "/tmp/x-cu-hd/err"))))))
  (display "made"))
```
---
    made

```cu
(hd-case ":" "GET / HTTP/1.0\\r\\n\\r\\n" (list))
```
---
```output
HTTP/1.1 200 OK<CR>
Connection: close<CR>
Content-type: text/html<CR>
Accept-Ranges: bytes<CR>
Last-Modified: Fri, 02 Jan 2026 03:04:05 GMT<CR>
ETag: "695735a5-6"<CR>
Content-Length: 6<CR>
<CR>
hello
[status 0]
```

## a listener

### -f -v -p PORT: two connections, each answered, -v naming each peer

```cu
(do (def hd-p0 (Socket tcp-listen 0)) (def hd-port (Socket local-port hd-p0)) (Socket close hd-p0)
  (hd-sh ":" "")
  (def hd-pid (sys-fork))
  (when (= hd-pid 0)
    (do (sys-dup2 (file-open-write "/tmp/x-cu-hd/log") 2)
        (cu-run (list "httpd" "-f" "-v" "-p" (%cu-int->str hd-port) "-h" hd-w) "")
        (sys-exit 0)))
  (def hd-ask (fn (_ req)
    (let ((c (let try ((n 0)) (let ((fd (guard (_ ()) (Socket tcp-connect "127.0.0.1" hd-port))))
                                (if (if (null? fd) (< n 200) #f) (do (sys-usleep 20000) (try (+ n 1))) fd)))))
      (do (Socket send c req)
          (let go ((acc "")) (let ((r (Socket recv-run c 4096)))
                               (if (null? r) (do (Socket close c) acc)
                                 (go (string-append acc (substring (first r) 0 (rest r)))))))))))
  (def hd-a (hd-ask "GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n"))
  (def hd-b (hd-ask "GET /nope HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n"))
  (sys-usleep 200000)
  (sys-kill hd-pid 9) (sys-wait hd-pid)
  (Sys chdir hd-home)
  (def hd-log (string-concat (map (fn (_ l) (let ((c (%wget-find l "]:")))
                                              (string-concat (list (substring l 0 (+ c 2)) "PORT"
                                                                   (substring l (%wget-index l #\: (+ c 2)) (byte-len l)) "\n"))))
                                  (hd-lines (file-read-all "/tmp/x-cu-hd/log")))))
  (display (string-concat (list "=== GET /\n" (Str8 replace "\r" "<CR>" (string-concat (map (fn (_ l) (string-append l "\n")) (filter (fn (_ l) (not (Str8 starts? "Date: " l))) (hd-lines hd-a)))))
                                "=== missing\n" (Str8 replace "\r" "<CR>" (string-concat (map (fn (_ l) (string-append l "\n")) (filter (fn (_ l) (not (Str8 starts? "Date: " l))) (hd-lines hd-b)))))
                                "=== log\n" hd-log))))
```
---
```output
=== GET /
HTTP/1.1 200 OK<CR>
Connection: close<CR>
Content-type: text/html<CR>
Accept-Ranges: bytes<CR>
Last-Modified: Fri, 02 Jan 2026 03:04:05 GMT<CR>
ETag: "695735a5-6"<CR>
Content-Length: 6<CR>
<CR>
hello
=== missing
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found<CR>
Connection: close<CR>
Content-type: text/html<CR>
<CR>
<HTML><HEAD><TITLE>404 Not Found</TITLE></HEAD>
<BODY><H1>404 Not Found</H1>
The requested URL was not found
</BODY></HTML>
=== log
[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:PORT: response:200
[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:PORT: response:404
```
